transformations.description: Uses the complete official EMT stop_code/codParada as the stable Málaga StopNode suffix and creates a same-code singleton StopPlace for each new identity.
Serializes all 5 frozen distinct exact GTFS sequences for routes 7, 15 and N2. Source-supported variants are preserved independently; this component has 0 contiguous short-working variant(s).
Applies the frozen loop registry exactly. One full-cycle N2 pattern closes a source-supported loop and receives exactly one last-to-first edge; all other patterns remain open.
Reuses the accepted canonical es-malaga identity fields exactly and computes only this package-local center/bounds from the 143 routed StopPlace coordinates with deterministic framing padding.
Adds exactly one catalog descriptor and recomputes asset and aggregate SHA-256 values from final serialized bytes.

warnings: The municipal Google Transit ZIP is the frozen topology authority for this snapshot. NAP metadata observed for the same network reports a different trip/calendar snapshot and remains provenance-only because its bytes were not downloaded.

All 143 component coordinates are either exact accepted Grade A objects (37 reused identities) or Grade B official structured municipal GTFS values (106 new identities); no coordinates are inferred or interpolated.
StopNode.sourceReferences is empty because no genuine OpenStreetMap platform or stop_position object was reconciled.

Thirty-seven target stop identities are exact-copied from the accepted Málaga baseline and 106 identities are newly created. Later Málaga components must continue to exact-copy accepted StopNode and StopPlace objects whenever IDs recur.
Routes CC, L and 20E are preserved in the frozen citywide source registry but excluded from passenger topology because the captured municipal snapshot contains zero trips for them.
